_readme: Human-declared prices for models no public catalogue knows.
A price here is an ASSERTION BY A PERSON, not a fact from a provider.
Every entry must therefore carry an as_of date and a note saying where
the number came from. features/board/pricing.py reports the source as
'local-override' so the dashboard can label it as user-declared rather
Do not add an entry you cannot source. A guessed price silently corrupts
every total that includes it, which is worse than the honest UNKNOWN this
The public catalogue (pydantic/genai-prices) already covers 450+ models
including gpt-6-astra. Only add entries for CUSTOM providers such as
mosicn / xingchiapi that no catalogue knows.

_example_nex-n2.6.note: where the number came from, in one sentence
